patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Agorapulse and Uniqode share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Agorapulse and Uniqode share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Agorapulse only if your buying job matches “Social scheduling plus unified inbox and reporting — per-user Standard/Professional/Advanc” rather than Uniqode's shape. Choose Uniqode only if your buying job matches “Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR;” rather than Agorapulse's shape. Workflow advantage: Agorapulse leans social-media-marketing, brand-monitoring; Uniqode leans lead-generation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Agorapulse and Uniqode share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Agorapulse is Social scheduling plus unified inbox and reporting — per-user Standard/Professional/Advanced with Custom enterprise.; Uniqode is Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR; paid dynamic from researched ~$9/mo floor..
- Company-size focus: Agorapulse (small-business, mid-market) vs Uniqode (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Agorapulse-leaning social-media-marketing, brand-monitoring vs Uniqode-leaning lead-generation.
- Researched limits: Agorapulse — Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams; Uniqode — Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Agorapulse: Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams; 10-profile cap on non-Custom plans without add-ons; Uniqode: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite; Plan cards hard to verify without live checkout.

Poor-fit cases: Agorapulse is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams · Uniqode is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite · Avoid Agorapulse if you actually need Uniqode's motion (Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
